'''2007 Maryland State Championship Greg Hitt LS Tatooine: City Outskirts''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Hitt]] at [[2007 Maryland State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: City Outskirts|Tat-L-tatooinecityoutskirts.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' LS ??
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
